card.name: Inside the word interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'interleukin' just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -6 or -15. It also fires on a few other partly spelled rare words and names.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The 'in' that finishes 'interleukin' before a hyphenated number or the abbreviation IL.

modes.label: Other split rare words
modes.description: Partway through uncommon names or foreign-script words.
